info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Segment Direction API
info.description: The Business Segment Direction API allows users to access and analyze the directional trends of various business segments. By utilizing specific parameters, consumers can retrieve strategic insights and data-driven recommendations that aid in decision-making processes. This API is designed for business analysts, financial planners, and strategic managers who require detailed segment analysis to drive growth and optimize business performance. Typical use cases include assessing market shifts, evaluating segment profitability, and aligning resources to capitalize on emerging trends.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of a specific segment direction using its unique identifier. It provides insights into the direction's attributes and associated business analysis, which can help in making informed decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters to retrieve segment direction analysis for a specific business. Ensure to provide all required data as per the schema defined.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource is returned.

GetSegmentDirectionByIdRequest.description: Request body for fetching operations within a segment direction.

segmentId.description: The unique identifier for the segment.

periodStart.description: The start date of the period for the analysis, in ISO 8601 format.

periodEnd.description: The end date of the period for the analysis, in ISO 8601 format.

baseCurrency.description: The base currency used for the financial analysis.

scenario.description: The scenario associated with the analysis.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record (e.g., active, archived).

version.description: The version number of the analysis record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the record was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the analysis response.
